title: UQE Evidence Report
description: Machine-checkable output contract for UQE verification. Every completion claim must be backed by a report validating against this schema: named artifacts, observed results, defects, and scores. No evidence object without a real artifact at 'path' that the agent actually inspected.

task.description: One-line description of what was done.

tier.description: Effort tier selected per SKILL.md Section 2.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of report creation (optional but recommended).

evidence.description: Named, inspectable artifacts. Empty array is invalid: no evidence means no completion claim.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the artifact file, or a canonical identifier (e.g. commit hash, URL) for non-file evidence.

observed.description: What the agent actually saw when inspecting the artifact. Must be a concrete observation, not a restatement of intent. 'SEEN standard': if you did not open it, you may not write it here.

quality.description: Evidence level per modules/evidence.md: E3 direct observation, E2 derived proxy, E1 asserted only.

defects.description: Findings from self-critique or verification. Omitted or empty means none found — which is itself a claim requiring evidence.

evidence_refs.description: Paths/ids of evidence items that show this defect.

scores.description: 1-10 quality metric scores. Any score key allowed; values must be integers 1-10.

manual_check.description: Exact command the user can run to close the gap.

unverified_claims.description: Honest disclosure list: claims made without sufficient evidence, why, and how the user can verify.
